description: One code, one status, across a product's whole API. A code's owner is the product that returns it. Seeded with four of SuperPipeline's codes on 2026-11-22; each API's codes are added when the API is contracted.

codes.meaning: The caller is not the agent that holds this run.
The principal that produced or asked for something cannot also decide it.
The caller's lease on the run is no longer the current one.
A board's stale-card settings are out of range.
